what: Month-by-month blog candidate queue for chrislloyd-io. The hourly worker drafts 1 candidate per month into blog-drafts/ following the conventions below. Promotion is NEVER automatic.

cadence.drafting_owner: blackboard hourly worker (picks from this backlog)
cadence.delivery_shape: draft .md (front matter: excerpt + seo_title) + <slug>-body.txt (paragraphs after the --- divider) + PROMOTE-<slug>.txt verbatim-runnable sidecar

conventions.promotion: OWNER-APPROVED ONLY (roadmap-51 #20 doctrine): promotion is one 'python3 scripts/add_post.py' call on explicit owner approval. Never auto-promoted.
conventions.no_stats: Never invent statistics, counts, or survey-like claims. Trade-cycle/seasonal reasoning only, matching data/promo-calendar.json.
conventions.cta: Soft CTA tail: one gentle closing line toward the target page. No hard sell, no fake urgency.
conventions.titles: Long-tail, question-style (scripts/add_post.py SEO note / task 017). Avoid generic transactional titles ('buy paint online').
conventions.current_position_note: blog-drafts/how-to-prep-walls-before-painting-edmonton.md is an untracked leftover matching an already-published post; keep or clean at owner discretion, not a backlog hole.
